integrity: A complete elementary reduction and exact 280-template finite certificate are provided. No infinite claim is inferred solely from bounded tests. All-length dependence is proved by a symbolic binomial-majorization inequality.
scientific_limitations: Exactly half GC content, a four-letter labeled alphabet, even lengths at least four, and forbidden overlap lengths one and two only. Longer overlaps and correction of substitutions or indels are not constrained. Historical priority is not independently established; a closely relevant article was only partially accessible.
title: Sharp GC-balanced two-overlap synchronization codes at every even length
